component.name: M5 FDM Studio
component.summary: Slicer and remote control for AnkerMake M5 and M5C printers

description.p: M5 FDM Studio is an unofficial community fork of eufyMake Studio for AnkerMake M5 and M5C printers. It replaces the closed-source network plugin with an open-source implementation, and offers slicing, remote printing control and live camera streaming.
It is based on eufyMake Studio, which is based on PrusaSlicer by Prusa Research. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anker or eufyMake.
